services.name: Farm Labor Bunkhouse
services.desc: The Filipino Bunkhouse was moved from Balestra Farms and donated to the Society by the Bunn & Yuki families in 2005. The structure was restored by the Filipino American National Historical Society (Monterey Bay Chapter) between 2006-2008 and depicts the living conditions of Filipino farm laborers in the 1940s-1940s. The interior exhibits were redesigned by Dr. Ruben Mendoza and California State University Monterey Bay Museum Studies Service Learning students in Spring 2022. Self Guided tours: Monday-Saturday, 9am-3pmFree of chargeSelf guided tours are of the grounds and building

services.name: Pat Hathaway
services.desc: , raised in Pacific Grove, assembled one of California’s largest privately held image collections. Upon his return to the Monterey Peninsula in 1968 after serving in the Vietnam war, Pat immediately began collecting historical images and also focused on his own passion for photography. In fact, his first exhibition was at the Pacific Grove Art Center in 1968 where he was also an artist n residence. Before suddenly passing in January 2021, Pat managed to assemble over 80,000 historical images, mostly of the Monterey Peninsula, Salinas Valley & California dating to the 1850s. His love of photography was immense as evidenced by over 470,000 of his own images chronicling daily life
